---
title: "Human Osteosarcoma Primary - Annotate Tumor Cells"
subtitle: "Cell type annotation reference assembly"
output: html_document
---

This script takes the output files from Primary-CreateData script (comb.qs)
and the Primary-Cluster script (selection.rds) to evaluate intratumoral
heterogeneity and to characterize tumor cell subclusters.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  dev = "svg",
  fig.width = 4,
  fig.height = 4,
  fig.asp = NULL
)

library(rrrSingleCellUtils)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(harmony)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)

set.seed(888)
```

# Isolate and subcluster the tumor cells

```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.width = 8}
# Isolate the tumor cells away from the comb Seurat object
selection <- readRDS("HuOsteo/selection.rds")
tumor <- subset(qs::qread("HuOsteo/comb.qs"), cells = selection)

# For now, subset out a representative sampling of tumors
tumor <- subset(tumor, src %in% c("BC6", "BC16", "BC20", "BC22"))

# Normalize and scale tumor dataset
tumor <- tumor %>%
  NormalizeData() %>%
  FindVariableFeatures() %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA(verbose = FALSE)

# Run batch-correction/integration using harmony
# tumor <- RunHarmony(tumor, group.by.vars = "src") %>%
#   RunUMAP(reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30) %>%
#   FindNeighbors(reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30, k.param = 30)

# plot <- list()
# opt <- tribble(
#   ~res, ~score, ~clusters
# )

# for(i in 1:9) {
#   opt[i, "res"] <- 0.05 * i + 1
#   tumor <- FindClusters(tumor, resolution = opt$res[i])
#   plot[[i]] <- r_dim_plot(tumor, paste("Resolution", opt$res[i]))
#   opt[i, "score"] <- silhouette_mean(silhouette_seurat(tumor))
#   opt[i, "clusters"] <- length(levels(tumor$seurat_clusters))
# }

# print(as_tibble(opt))

# ggsave("Plots/UMAP-all-tumor-cells.pdf",
#   wrap_plots(plot[1:5], ncol = 3),
#   device = "pdf",
#   width = 12,
#   height = 8,
#   units = "in")

# Manually enforcing a resolution of 0.2 based on review of clusters
# and potential DEGs. Silhouette performs poorly for scoring intratumor
# heterogeneity.
tumor <- FindClusters(tumor, resolution = 0.2)
clusters <- levels(factor(tumor$seurat_clusters))
names(clusters) <- paste0("Cluster", clusters)

tumor <- run_fdl(tumor)
r_dim_plot(tumor, reduction = "fdl") +
  labs(title = "Primary tumor cells")

tumor <- kill_cc(tumor)
Idents(tumor) <- tumor$seurat_clusters

r_dim_plot(tumor,
    reduction = "fdl",
    group.by = "Phase",
    label = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Human Primary Tumor - Cell Cycle") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

qs::qsave(tumor, "HuOsteo/comb-tumor.qs")
```

gs <- "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB"

cell_ranks <- AUCell::AUCell_run(
  tumor[["RNA"]]$counts,
  sigs %>% filter(gs_name == gs) %>% pull(gene_symbol)
)

tumor$nfkb_activity <- AUCell::getAUC(cell_ranks)[1,]

FeaturePlot(tumor,
  "nfkb_activity",
  reduction = "fdl",
  cols = c("#EEEEEE", "#ae0600"),
  min.cutoff = 0.15,
  pt.size = 1,
  order = TRUE) +
  coord_fixed()

FeaturePlot(tumor,
  "IL1R1",
  reduction = "fdl",
  cols = c("#EEEEEE", "#ae0600"),
  min.cutoff = 1,
  max.cutoff = 4.8,
  pt.size = 1,
  order = TRUE) +
  coord_fixed()
